# Board power provenance

Apache-2.0 files `board_power.c` and `board_power.h` copied without modification
from Keitark/fm1-nes commit `870f3054869c77f03fc1c8a3a425dafa3dfa7b22`, paths
`firmware/nes/boot/board_power.{c,h}`.
Source: https://github.com/Keitark/fm1-nes/tree/870f3054869c77f03fc1c8a3a425dafa3dfa7b22
The selectors are checked against pinned JieLi headers. Their stock FM-1_010
provenance is upstream reported evidence; owner FM-1_092 voltages are unmeasured.
No NES, GPL audio/USB or GPL HAL code is included.
